purpose: Whether the theater allocation helps the attacker in Western Europe attack games. Observation, not a promotion gate.
userRequest: 2026-10-21: complete the implementation and learn whether it helps; promotion is far off; Western Europe only (docs/ai/vp-metrics.md).
source: committed source of this registration; theaterAllocation 0 is the standard heuristic@85

games.matches: 2100000-2100079 (no save with these numbers exists in any checkout)
games.command: node scripts/ai-match.mjs --matches 80 --start 2100000 --style WESTERN_EUROPE --engagement AXIS_ATTACKS --turns 8 --size 32x24 --divisions 6 --armored 2 --air NONE --air-transport NONE --allied heuristic:docs/quality/evidence/ai-theater-allocation-games-2026-10-21/theater-weights.json --axis heuristic --swap --parallel 12 --out artifacts/ai-theater-allocation-games/attack-western

measures.primary: VP margin, theater-on side minus standard side, averaged over the two seat-swapped games of a pair; mean over 40 pairs with a 95% t interval
secondary: Kill - Loss steps (on side), same pairing
Supply: units the opponent ends out of supply minus own
Game Turn 1-3 attacker potential, realized value at Combat entry and objective VP gained, on side versus standard side (ai-position-record.mjs --theater)

reading: Helps on VP if the 95% interval of the primary is above 0; hurts if below 0; otherwise not established at this size. No further games are added to this batch.
power: Per-pair VP SD about 5.4 from the 12 complete Western pairs observed earlier; 40 pairs give SE about 0.85, power about 0.65 for a true +2 VP a pair and about 0.98 for +3.
